summary.text: James Hendershot is an independent candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Democrat Marley Umensetter and Republican Melissa McCrady.

paragraphs.text: Hendershot earned a high school diploma from Parkersburg High School and a bachelor's degree from West Virginia University at Parkersburg in 2025.
His career experience includes working in retail.
